name: measured_camera_realsensor
_comment: measured_camera with the *injected* sensing noise removed, so the only
pose error is whatever the CNN in the loop actually makes.
measured_camera models the wrist camera by drawing position error from a
0.03-0.078 m band, correlated in time. That band was calibrated from this
repository's own estimator, so the magnitudes agree -- but a draw from a
band is random every episode, while the estimator is a deterministic
function of the image: the same scene always yields the same wrong pose.
A policy can learn to invert a repeatable distortion and cannot invert a
This level exists so that difference can be measured with the dynamics
held identical. Comparing a CNN-in-the-loop run at `none` against a
measured_camera run would compare sensing *and* friction, mass, latency,
compliance and gripper gain at once.
